events.description: A sudden large fireball with dense smoke erupts ahead of the vehicle at f5, peaks at f6, and begins dissipating by f7.

verification.reason: f5 shows a bright orange fireball with rapid expansion and smoke; f6 shows sustained intense flame and black smoke; f7 shows residual smoke and no vehicle deformation—consistent with an explosion, not a crash. Only candidate 1 is supported.
